notes.notes:
【Game update announcement】

V.477 Version Update:
1. [Function] If there are Bugcats on the desktop when the program is closed (the desktop status is recorded every minute), these Bugcats will be called out automatically when the program is started again.
2. [Correction] Adjustment of some system data settings.

1.Fixed an issue where the bugcat illustrated book may exceed the screen range after changing the resolution.


2.If the Mac version cannot be updated, please uninstall the program and reinstall it.
1.Fixed an issue where the bugcat illustrated book may exceed the screen range after changing the resolution.

[Windows]
1.Adjust presentation method to optimize dynamic latency issues that may arise when calling a large number of bugcats.
2.Switch from opening the bugcat Illustrated Book with a right-click of the mouse to opening it with a left-click of the mouse.
3.Optimization adjustment of the product: the screen extension function is changed to selecting the graphic key for the screen where the bugcat are located (M for the main screen, E for the secondary screen).
4.Merge the bugcat top function and the small graphic key top function into a program top function.
5.Change the function of displaying the name of the bugcat when right-clicking to show the name of the bugcat when the mouse hovers over it.

[Mac]
1.Fixed sound effect issue

notes.title: 2023/6/6 Update Note
notes.notes:
1. Update the tutorial.
2. Update the Capoo book User Interface.
3. Bug fixed of display of Bugcat.
4. Addin the detection of record files. Users can reset the data to login when the data on the cloud is damage
   a. Users need to unlock all the bugcats again after the data is reset.
   b. The data reset wouldn't affect the achievements you have earned.
